pages.title: Djinni Crusher
pages.text: The djinni crusher is faster, more efficient and proficient than the foliot crusher.$(br)Allowing ice to be crushed without melting.$(br2)It will crush $(bold)one$() ore into $(bold)three$() corresponding dusts.$(br)

pages.title: Filters
pages.text: This spirit already only picks up items it has recipes for.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to further restrict which valid inputs it will take.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details.$()
